Shell Type Needle Roller Bearings (Inch Series)

An inch-spec bearing assembled with a needle roller assembly in a thin, heat-treated steel-plate cup-shaped outer ring.

Supplied in two types, BA (open type) and BHA (closed type), and mainly used as maintenance parts for North American/European spec equipment.

You can search by entering just the model number or part of the dimensions.
